title: Massive MSFS 2024 Scenery Drop! (Free Upgrade + 8 New Airports)
description:
If you're looking to expand your virtual flight log across international airline routes, military bases, and scenic general aviation hops, the Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace just rolled out an impressive wave of scenery and utilities! Whether you're operating wide-body turns into Jakarta, tracking low-level Eurofighter sorties out of RAF Coningsby, island-hopping across a massive 5-airport Catalan collection in Spain, or claiming a free cross-buy upgrade for Lafayette Regional, this week's drop brings outstanding variety for every type of pilot.

In this scenery breakdown, we inspect the latest airfield arrivals, visual quality, terminal modeling, and system utilities to help you decide what deserves space on your virtual drive:

✈️ INTERNATIONAL & REGIONAL COMMERCIAL GATEWAYS
We open with Soekarno–Hatta International Airport in Jakarta (WIII), featuring overhauled high-resolution aprons, updated night lighting, terminal wear-and-tear, and the modeled airport skytrain. Next, we travel to South Africa for Polokwane International Airport (FAPG) by NMG Simulations—a former military base turned regional hub with scheduled connections to Johannesburg. We also review Lafayette Regional Airport (KLFT) in Louisiana, highlighting an important perk: if you owned the MSFS 2020 edition by MSFSceneryBuilders, you can claim this 2024 version as a completely free cross-buy upgrade!

🛩️ EUROPEAN AIRFIELDS & THE CATALAN GA COLLECTION
Next, we visit Surrey, England, for Burning Blue Design’s rendition of Fairoaks Airport (EGTF), packed with custom hangars, cafe interiors, animated spectators, and the nearby McLaren Technology Centre. From there, we explore an entire 5-airport regional hub across Catalonia, Spain by Foot/Food Designs:
- Sabadell Airport (LELL) – Barcelona's bustling flight training center
- La Cerdanya (LECD) – A high-altitude Pyrenees haven for gliders and skydiving
- Igualada-Òdena Aerodrome (LEIG) – A favorite for practice touch-and-goes near Montserrat
- Empuriabrava Aerodrome (LEAP) – The canal-laced skydiving capital with animated jumpers
- Viladamat Airfield (LEWG) – A picturesque grass strip near Figueres and the French border

🎯 MILITARY BASES, URBAN LANDMARKS & SIM UTILITIES
For military flyers, RAF Coningsby (EGXC) brings authentic UK Typhoon operations to life with static Eurofighters, QRA facilities, hardened shelters, and custom lighting. Looking across the Atlantic, Tulsa City Landmarks adds 150 custom 3D buildings and Art Deco high-rises to Oklahoma. Finally, we evaluate new sim utilities, including 220+ atmospheric weather presets, the Airfo Link mobile flight tracker, and standalone night lighting overhauls for Pittsburgh, Geneva, Chengdu, and Brasília.

Which of these new marketplace additions are you flying into first? Taking airliners into Jakarta, touring the grass strips of Catalonia, or claiming your free upgrade at Lafayette? Let us know in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you navigate the latest MSFS 2024 scenery releases, don't forget to hit like, subscribe to the channel for weekly simulator coverage, and clear skies on your next departure!
